decisions.reason: The transactional email service builds on the firm's core messaging infrastructure and was featured on the home page, so its option value remains high and carrying it costs little.
Managed capture has a documented customer adoption and fits the firm's electronic document workflow strategy, so the option is resolving favorably and justifies further commitment.
Email and fax conversion uses existing gateways at low marginal cost and serves regulated customers who still rely on fax, so it is cheap to keep while demand persists.
This feature sits close to the established fax business and costs little to maintain, although fax decline makes its long-term value less certain than the other products.

Sandbox threat protection addresses a growing security need within the firm's email security suite, so it holds substantial option value at low incremental cost, unlike the dropped multi-engine scanner.
